page_title: Collate — Private AI for Your PDFs on Mac

sources.entry: Collate - Free tool to collect, summarize and query PDFs with AI. All offline and free. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/collateai/id6447429913?platform=mac) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Collate
summary.one_liner: A native macOS PDF workspace that lets you chat with PDFs, get summaries, and trace answers back to the source page, using on-device Local AI or an optional bring-your-own-key cloud model.
use_cases: chatting with a single PDF or a whole folder of PDFs
summarizing long documents before reading closely
tracing AI answers back to the exact page
reading sensitive documents without sending them to a cloud model
highlighting, organizing, and exporting PDF notes
summary.what_it_does: Collate lets you add a single PDF or a whole folder and then chat with them, getting answers grounded in the document content. It produces summaries intended to show the structure of a long document. Answers include citations that link back to the exact page in the source. You can highlight passages, save answers, and export them. Local AI runs document inference on the Mac after a one-time model download, so document content is not sent to a cloud provider; users can alternatively bring their own API key for cloud models.
notable: Local AI mode runs inference on the Mac with no cloud model provider
Citations trace answers back to the exact PDF page
Optional bring-your-own-key cloud models, with the active mode always shown
caveats: Local AI needs a local model downloaded once; cloud mode requires the user's own key
Listed as free, but the page does not describe paid tiers or limits
